routes.summary: Inspect and modify WordPress runtime, diagnostics, debug configuration and bridge capabilities
routes.description: Read/write system control for status, capabilities, health, environment, runtime and debug settings, maintenance mode, fixes and verification. Mutations use the shared backup, diff, verification and rollback contract.

routes.summary: Search, preview-replace and replace content across WordPress data and site files
routes.description: Search content, users, comments, files and database records; preview, apply, undo and verify replacements. Mutations use the shared backup, diff, verification and rollback contract.

routes.summary: Create, inspect, verify, download, restore and delete database, files or full-site backups
routes.description: Read/write control surface. Supported actions: capabilities, list, get, create, verify, export_manifest, restore, delete, prune, status. Write actions use the mutation contract and return backup, before/after diff, verification and rollback metadata.

routes.summary: Inspect, configure and flush object cache, page cache, transients, CDN cache and rewrite rules
routes.description: Inspect and modify transients, object/page/CDN caches and rewrite rules, including targeted deletion and full flushes. Mutations use the shared backup, diff, verification and rollback contract.

routes.summary: List, inspect, run, schedule, reschedule and remove WordPress cron and Action Scheduler jobs
routes.description: List, inspect, run, schedule, reschedule or remove WordPress cron and Action Scheduler jobs. Mutations use the shared backup, diff, verification and rollback contract.

routes.summary: List, read, search, download, configure, rotate, truncate or delete WordPress and WooCommerce logs
routes.description: Read/write control surface. Supported actions: list, read, tail, search, download, set_logging, rotate, truncate, clear, delete, verify. Write actions use the mutation contract and return backup, before/after diff, verification and rollback metadata.

routes.summary: Create, read, update, patch, publish, revise, restore and delete all WordPress content types
routes.description: Full CRUD for pages, posts, blocks and registered content types, including statuses, scheduling, authorship, templates, featured media, revisions, block repair, reusable blocks, bulk publication and verified deletion.

routes.summary: Create, read, update, merge, assign, reorder and delete categories, tags and custom terms
routes.description: Full CRUD for categories, tags and registered taxonomies, including metadata, hierarchy, slugs, ordering, assignments, imports, exports, duplicate detection, merges, redirects, synchronization and count verification.

routes.summary: Upload, inspect, edit, replace, regenerate, optimize and delete WordPress media and metadata
routes.description: Full media-library control: list, upload, replace, edit, optimize, regenerate metadata or thumbnails, set alt text, attach, detach, trash, restore, delete and verify.

routes.summary: Create, read, edit, moderate, reply to, spam, trash, restore and delete comments and reviews
routes.description: Read/write control surface. Supported actions: list, get, create, reply, update, approve, hold, spam, unspam, trash, restore, delete, bulk_moderate, search, verify. Write actions use the mutation contract and return backup, before/after diff, verification and rollback metadata.

routes.summary: Create, read, update, role-manage, session-manage and delete WordPress users
routes.description: Full user administration: CRUD, roles, passwords, sessions, application passwords, search, reassignment and deletion. Mutations use audited backup, diff, verification and rollback.

routes.summary: Create, read, update, reorder, assign and delete menus, navigation items and locations
routes.description: Create, read, update and delete menus and menu items; move or reorder items and assign theme locations. Mutations use the shared backup, diff, verification and rollback contract.

routes.summary: Create, read, update, move and delete widgets, sidebars and block-widget instances
routes.description: Read/write control surface. Supported actions: list_sidebars, get_sidebar, list_widget_types, list, get, create, update, move, reorder, deactivate, delete, verify. Write actions use the mutation contract and return backup, before/after diff, verification and rollback metadata.

routes.summary: Create, read, patch, revise, restore and delete templates, template parts and global styles
routes.description: Full control of templates, template parts, revisions and global styles, including create, patch, restore and delete. Mutations use the shared backup, diff, verification and rollback contract.

routes.summary: Read, write, patch, version and roll back Custom CSS, theme styles and generated design tokens
routes.description: Read, write, append, patch, version or remove Custom CSS, theme.json and global styles, with rollback and verification. All mutations return before/after audit data.

routes.summary: Read and write WordPress settings, registered options and controlled raw options
routes.description: Read and write registered settings and WordPress options, individually or in bulk, with import, export and verification. Mutations use audited backup, diff and rollback.

routes.summary: List, inspect, install, upload, activate, deactivate, update, roll back and delete plugins
routes.description: Full read/write plugin administration: install, activate, update, create, inspect, test and patch plugin files, settings, hooks, REST routes, blocks, assets, dependencies, database tables and build outputs with rollback.

routes.summary: List, inspect, install, upload, activate, update, customize, roll back and delete themes
routes.description: Full read/write theme administration: install, activate, update, clone, export, inspect, validate and patch theme files, templates, patterns, theme.json, style variations, fonts, assets, hooks and build outputs with rollback.

routes.summary: Create, read, update, duplicate, publish and delete WooCommerce catalog resources
routes.description: Full WooCommerce product control, including CRUD, bulk operations, publication, variations, categories, tags, attributes, reviews, trash, restore and verification.

routes.summary: Read and write prices, stock, backorders and inventory state individually or in bulk
routes.description: Read/write control surface. Supported actions: get, bulk_get, set_stock, adjust_stock, set_stock_status, set_price, set_sale, clear_sale, bulk_update, import, export, reconcile, verify. Write actions use the mutation contract and return backup, before/after diff, verification and rollback metadata.

routes.summary: Create, read, update, fulfill, refund, note, trash, restore and delete WooCommerce orders
routes.description: Full WooCommerce order control, including CRUD, statuses, notes, refunds, payment capture, bulk updates, export, trash, restore, deletion and verification.

routes.summary: Create, read, update, merge, export, anonymize and delete WooCommerce customers
routes.description: Read/write control surface. Supported actions: list, get, create, update, merge, reset_password, export, anonymize, delete, bulk_update, search, verify. Write actions use the mutation contract and return backup, before/after diff, verification and rollback metadata.

routes.summary: Create, read, update, enable, disable, duplicate and delete WooCommerce coupons
routes.description: Read/write control surface. Supported actions: list, get, create, update, duplicate, enable, disable, bulk_update, delete, verify. Write actions use the mutation contract and return backup, before/after diff, verification and rollback metadata.

routes.summary: Read and write WooCommerce settings, taxes, shipping, gateways, webhooks, reports and status tools
routes.description: Read and write WooCommerce settings, shipping, taxes, gateways, webhooks, reports and status tools, with import, export and verification through the shared mutation contract.

routes.summary: Audit and write technical, on-page, local and ecommerce SEO across WordPress and WooCommerce
routes.description: Read and write technical, local, editorial and ecommerce SEO. Every audit_* action collects Site Kit, GSC, GA4 and PageSpeed evidence, performs current web research, applies a targeted fix, verifies it and rolls back on failure.

routes.summary: Audit and administer every file and directory inside the configured WordPress site root
routes.description: Read, audit, create, patch, move and delete files inside the WordPress root. Every audit_* lifecycle action belongs to the same research, remediation, backup, diff, verification and rollback workflow.

routes.summary: Inspect, query, mutate, migrate, export, import, optimize and restore the WordPress database
routes.description: Inspect, query and modify the WordPress database with bounded SQL, CRUD, DDL, batches, transactions, search/replace, import/export, optimize, repair, snapshots, restore and verification.

routes.summary: Inspect and execute WordPress, plugin, theme, database and WooCommerce maintenance operations
routes.description: Control WordPress maintenance and updates for core, plugins, themes and translations; optimize or repair the database, regenerate thumbnails, flush rewrites and run integrity checks.

routes.summary: Control and verify the same-site frontend with Playwright, Chromium, DOM, CSS, JavaScript and pixel comparisons
routes.description: Read and modify the same-site frontend; automate Chromium with Playwright; inspect DOM, accessibility, network, console and performance; run tests, traces, HAR, screenshots, visual diffs, CSS/asset patches and post-write verification.

routes.summary: Audit and remediate WordPress accounts, permissions, integrity, hardening and access credentials
routes.description: Audit and write security configuration, permissions, sessions, integrity baselines and quarantine state. Every audit_* action uses current research, targeted fixes, mandatory backup for destructive changes and verification.

routes.summary: Manage Google Web Stories: storie, dati editor, revisioni, lock, media, loghi publisher, font, template, tassonomie e impostazioni
routes.description: Controllo completo del plugin Google Web Stories tramite le sue route REST native /web-stories/v1/*. Le azioni distruttive richiedono confirm=true, ogni comando supporta dry_run e viene eseguito dal modulo PRSTUDIO_Web_Stories_Manage con audit del bridge.
